title: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Developer
description:
Roles & Responsibilities : We are seeking a hands-on SFCC Senior Engineer with strong experience in Salesforce PWA Kit , React , and Headless Commerce . The candidate should be capable of independently delivering features, collaborating across teams, and building scalable storefront experiences. 
 Key Responsibilities Develop enterprise-grade commerce storefronts using Salesforce PWA Kit. Build reusable React components and frontend libraries. Integrate SFCC APIs and commerce services. Implement responsive and accessible user experiences. Optimize application performance and user experience. Collaborate with Product Owners, Designers, QA, and Backend Engineers. Debug production issues and support ongoing enhancements. Participate in code reviews and technical discussions. Required Skills Professional Skills Strong Communication & Collaboration Delivery Ownership Problem Solving & Debugging Cross-Functional Collaboration Time Management & Prioritization Quality & Maintainability Focus Technical Skills React.js JavaScript (ES6+) / TypeScript Salesforce PWA Kit Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) SCAPI Integrations Headless / Composable Commerce Concepts Frontend Performance Optimization Debugging & Troubleshooting REST APIs Responsive UI Development Good to Have Amplience CMS CMS-Driven Frontend Development Commerce SDK Chakra UI GraphQL Testing Frameworks (Jest, React Testing Library) Client Screening Priorities Candidates should demonstrate strong hands-on experience with: Salesforce PWA Kit (not just SFRA/SFCC) React.js and modern TypeScript development Reusable component-based architecture Headless and composable commerce implementations SCAPI integration in storefront applications SSR, hydration, caching, and rendering optimization Frontend performance and Core Web Vitals improvements Technical ownership and architectural decision-making Mentoring and leadership capabilities Ability to explain technical trade-offs and design decisions Preferred candidate profile
